assumptions: Same machine and similar background load; unchanged source and workload settings.
Five scenarios, Revised only, all five phases, one warm-up and five measured repetitions where required.
Same 60-second worker and 900-second measurement campaign caps.
Comparable missing-workload generation is included because the reference command generated all five workloads.
Planning interval is 0.8 to 1.5 times the one observed command duration, not a confidence interval.
Different seeds can change book depth, fill counts and cleanup costs; one large seed is not a runtime guarantee.
Post-run tests, audits, report generation and inter-command gaps are excluded.
interval_caveat: Progress intervals include parent work and are not exact worker execution measurements; the first includes preparation.
